title: Just Juice Mango & Passion Fruit Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: This e-liquid from Just Juice offers a blend of ripe, juicy mango with exotic passionfruit flavours for a subtle tart sweetness. As tropical as e-juice gets, you’d think you were vaping pure Caribbean sunshine with this premium e-liquid from Just Juice. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits just the right spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod Vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the fast-acting nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
